data.title: Why 42 Macro says it’s waiting to buy the Bitcoin dip
data.description: Darius Dale, founder and CEO of 42 Macro, says his firm has trimmed its Bitcoin exposure and is waiting for signs that the sell-off has run its course before it considers buying again.“We’ve already de-risked out of Bitcoin,” Dale said in an interview with Cointelegraph last week. “Our stress level…
